settings.disk_acceleration: Caprice32 default; record actual config hash

measurement.counter: sum of Caprice32 z80_wait_states iCycleCount, including instruction/interrupt execution
measurement.guest_marker_address: 0x3FFF when BH2_TELEMETRY_PHASE_MARKERS is enabled; external PC markers do not alter guest code

limits: Cycle totals are from the documented, pinned Caprice32 Z80 model, not measurements on a physical CPC.
The timing emulator is instrumented on host-side PC boundaries; guest T-states are not incremented by trace output.
The current profile disables audio output/emulation for calibration; audio integration requires a separate measured profile.
